Shishiku"He too... whatever little thing was under his nose, that was everything. The whole picture? Never once did he see it."

Shishiku"In an ordinary citizen you call it kindness. Put that same quality in a ruler and what is it? Weakness. A vice, not a virtue! Your father did not know even this much!"
Kanae"............"

en.html:
No. That was wrong.

Her father, Tokitsugu Ootori, knew.
All the time he worried.

Was his decision wrong? In the end, would his people have to bear still greater hardship because of it?

The path he believed in, the path he had chosen—he was running down it with everything he had. And still he doubted. Still he suffered over whether he was right.

...Of this, the man knew nothing.
For himself, never a doubt. For her father's anguish, not one bit of understanding.

Why!

Kanae knew. So far away overseas she had been, and still her father's suffering was clear to her as something held in her own hand.

This man did not know.
Standing right beside her father!

Had he understood, had he opened his heart and spoken his mind, the Ootori house would have recovered. That much talent he had. That much generosity her father had, to hear him.

But he did not do it.
To her father he gave only the blade that cut them apart.

No. That was wrong.

Her father, Tokitsugu Ootori, knew.
All the time he worried.

Was his decision wrong? In the end, would his people have to bear still greater hardship because of it?

The path he believed in, the path he had chosen—he was running down it with everything he had. And still he doubted. Still he suffered over whether he was right.

...Of this, the man knew nothing.
For himself, never a doubt. For her father's anguish, not one bit of understanding.

Why!

Kanae knew. So far away overseas she had been, and still her father's suffering was clear to her as something held in her own hand.

This man did not know.
Standing right beside her father!

Had he understood, had he opened his heart and spoken his mind, the Ootori house would have recovered. That much talent he had. That much generosity her father had, to hear him.

But he did not do it.
To her father he gave only the blade that cut them apart.

en.html:
“I have heard you are fond of flowers, Kanae madam.”

“If you would accept these...”

“I hope they are to your liking. I—well, about choosing good flowers, I know absolutely nothing.”

“...Yes. Yesterday evening I was informed.”

“The succession to the Shirakawa branch is formally decided... and my name is to change from Arata Ootori to Shishiku. Also... the engagement...”

“My feelings...? What I feel...”

“I know Elder Nagakura arranged it to bring my lord Tokiharu and your father Tokitsugu together. Between the two of them, so often there is quarreling.”

“I know also what the servants are whispering about you. Such unkind rumours.”

“But... that has nothing to do with this.”

“For a very long time, Kanae madam...”

“That you are beautiful—this only I have thought.”

“...Kanae madam...”

“If an outsider like me, with such doubtful origins—if even so you would accept me as your husband...”

“This Arata—no, Shishiku—will become a warrior worthy of the Ootori name. Your engagement to me, I will never let you look back and say it was a mistake!”

〝香奈枝様は花がお好きとか〟

〝宜しければ、これを……〟

〝お好みに合えば良いのですが。
　僕――自分には、花の良し悪しなどとんと
わかりませず〟

〝……はい。
　昨夕、承りました〟

〝白河の分家を継ぐ一件が正式に決まった事
……併せて大鳥<ruby>新<rt>あらた</rt></ruby>の名を獅子吼と改める事。
　そして……婚約の事も……〟

〝気持ち……ですか？
　自分の……〟

〝今回の件が我が主たる時治様と、香奈枝様
の御父上であられる時継様――とかく諍いの
多いこのお二人の仲を取り持つため、永倉老
に仕組まれたものである事は存じております〟

〝香奈枝様について、口さがない使用人達が
良からぬ噂を囁いている事も知っております〟

〝しかし……関係ありません〟

〝自分は、ずっと以前から……
　香奈枝様のことを〟

〝お美しい御方とのみ、想ってまいりました〟

〝……香奈枝様……〟

〝もし――
　自分ごとき、素性あやしき他所者の伴侶に
なっても良いと、あなたが思し召すのなら〟

〝この新、いえ獅子吼は――必ずや大鳥の姓
を冠するに相応しき<ruby>武人<rt>もののふ</rt></ruby>となり……
　決して香奈枝様に、自分との婚約を、誤り
であったと嘆かせは致しませぬ！〟
